sloka: सुषेणस्तु महावीर्यो गिरिकूटोपमो हरिः ।बहुभिः संवृतस्तत्र वानरैः कामरूपिभिः ।। ६.४१.९३ ।।।।
transliteration: suṣeṇastu mahāvīryo girikūṭopamo hariḥ ।bahubhiḥ saṁvṛtastatra vānaraiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ ।। 6.41.93 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana exhibiting extreme anger at the shattering of his palace and seeing his destruction started sighing heavily.
